verdicts.rationale: Identical title, authors, year, journal, volume/pages, and DOI across both members.
All three are Gendler 'Alief and Belief' (2008) with identical fields and shared DOI.
Gentner 'Structure-mapping' 1983; identical fields and DOI, only type differs (article vs misc).
Medin/Goldstone/Gentner 'Respects for similarity' 1993; identical fields and DOI.

Markman & Gentner 'Structural Alignment during Similarity Comparisons' 1993, same authors/pages/year; second member has a wrong journal name (WIREs Cog Sci) but is the same work matched by title+year+author.
Gentner & Markman 'Structure mapping in analogy and similarity' 1997; identical fields and DOI.
Georgopoulos et al. 'Mental Rotation of the Neuronal Population Vector'; identical fields and DOI, only type differs.
Germeys & d'Ydewalle 'The psychology of film' 2007; identical fields and DOI.
Gerrig 'Experiencing narrative worlds' 1993; identical title, author, year, publisher, ISBN.

Geschwind 'Disconnexion Syndromes' 1965; all three share the same DOI, title, author, volume/pages (237-237). The i/ii citekey suffixes do not correspond to distinct Part I/II works — fields are identical.
Gettier 'Is Justified True Belief Knowledge?' 1963; identical fields and DOI.
Geurts 'Good news about the description theory of names' 1997; identical fields and DOI.

Giannetti 'Understanding Movies' matched by title only across three different editions/years (1982, 1987, 2002) with no shared DOI; these are distinct editions of the same textbook — safer to keep separate.
Faculty Opinions recommendation (de Lecea & Giardino, 2015); identical fields and DOI.

Gibbard & Harper 'Counterfactuals and Two Kinds of Expected Utility' 1978; same title/authors/year. Members carry different DOIs and pages (two reprint volumes) but are the same underlying paper matched by title+year+author.
Gibbard 'Two Recent Theories of Conditionals'; identical fields and DOI.

Gibson 'The visual field and the visual world: a reply to Professor Boring' 1952; identical fields and DOI.
Giere 'How Models Are Used to Represent Reality' 2004; identical fields and DOI.
Gigerenzer & Goldstein 'Reasoning the fast and frugal way' 1996; identical fields and DOI.

Gilbert 'How mental systems believe' 1991; identical fields and DOI.
Gilchrist et al. 'An anchoring theory of lightness perception' 1999; identical fields and DOI.
Gilchrist 'Perceptual Organization in Lightness'; identical fields and DOI.
Gill 'Trapline Foraging by Hermit Hummingbirds' 1988; identical fields and DOI.
